verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 104.0 (-1.2% in a day) and momentum is 48: prices are steady. 84s cost 700, 85s 1,800 and 86s 4,200. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-17T20:26:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Lewis Hall 86 Future Stars after its 38% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 94,000 coins. Now 98,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 38.2% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 2 so far, averaging +5.0% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Capdevila 86 Base Hero after its 19% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 142,000 coins. Now 155,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 19.3% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 2 so far, averaging +5.0% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 1,800 (0.86 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,200 (1.02 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,000 (1.09 coins per Item Score point), 88s 10,500 (1.27 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Taylor Harwood-Bellis and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Taylor Harwood-Bellis 75 Rare -67.1%; Merveille Kanjinga 85 Future Stars -51.4%; Kerim Alajbegović 86 Future Stars -51.1%; Nemanja Vidić 88 Base Icon -50.1%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
